name: Napa
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Napa for 2026, and here is what he found: 13 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Silverado tree lighting) through January 3, 2027 (Holidays at The Meritage, with ice skating), with the Christmas Parade (December 5), Visits with Santa in Yountville (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Silverado (Saturdays from November 28), the Santa Train Jolly Journeys on the Napa Valley Wine Train (December 21 to 23) and the Holiday Lights Tour on the Napa Valley Wine Trolley (weekends in December) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Napa

  • 13 Christmas events for kids in Napa
  • 4 free events, including the Christmas Parade, Jingle Jam for Families, the Santa Train rides at Silverado Resort and Visits with Santa in Yountville
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at Silverado (Saturdays November 28 to December 19), Santa's Reading Corner at The Meritage (weekends), Brunch with Santa at Enchanted Hills Camp (December 12) and Yountville visits (December 5)
  • Trains and lights: the Santa Train Jolly Journeys on the Napa Valley Wine Train (December 21 to 23), the Santa Train rides at Silverado Resort and the Holiday Lights Tour on the Wine Trolley (December 4 to 20)
  • Ice skating: Merry Meritage Holiday Ice Skating (November 19 to January 3, 2027)
  • Shows: the Napa Regional Dance Company's The Nutcracker (December 20)
  • Season: November 27 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Napa families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Santa Rosa, with more Sonoma County events within an hour.
